messages:
Ravi (Design): dropping a new proposal for the Rollout Timeline scrubber and version quick-actions: https://www.figma.com/file/new/rollout-scrubber. goals: faster keyboard scrubbing, clearer rollback microcopy, and a low-noise canary allocation indicator. looking for keyboard/a11y + engineering feasibility notes.
Cam (PM): thanks. two product asks: 1) make scrubbing show a live preview of traffic split (so users can inspect before applying), 2) CTA copy should be explicit: avoid verbs alone (e.g., not just \"Rollback\").
Tess (Eng): feasible but notes: live preview on hover/scrub will need server-side snapshot endpoints for accurate metrics at each checkpoint; otherwise we'll show estimated values client-side. virtualization for history is still required if users have hundreds of versions.
Marta (A11y): a11y high level: scrubbing must be keyboard operable (arrow keys + page up/down), and SR should announce the version under focus like \"Version v4.2, canary 5%\". use aria-roledescription=\"slider\" for the scrubber and ensure role=\"list\" for the timeline rows.
rollout-bot: automated check: contrast issue detected on small muted legend text (#8A9398 on #FFFFFF) ratio 2.6:1. recommend darker token #42484B.
Ravi (Design): noted. copy options for the rollback CTA I ran by the product team: A) \"Rollback to v{X}\" B) \"Revert service to v{X}\" C) \"Start rollback\". any preference? also thinking of adding helper text: \"Undo available for 5 minutes.\"
Cam (PM): prefer A or B. A is concise and matches action in audit logs. B is more explicit about scope (service). let's A/B test A vs B for clarity. keep helper text about undo.
Tess (Eng): from an implementation standpoint, include the version identifier in the button so logs and analytics can attach easily. also suggest a two-step inline flow: first click reveals confirm inline (\"Confirm: Rollback to vX / Cancel\") rather than a full modal for speed.
Marta (A11y): two-step inline is fine if we move focus to the confirm button and announce via aria-live: \"Rollback confirmation dialog: Rollback to v4.2, undo available for 5 minutes.\" pressing Escape should cancel and return focus to the original control. avoid hover-only reveals for the undo TTL.
Ravi (Design): design tweaks: 1) scrubber drag handle only appears on hover/focus to reduce clutter, 2) canary allocation shown as thin filled bar + numeric percent, 3) add small timestamp under each version in compact mode.
Cam (PM): small timestamp is useful for incident investigations. keep it muted. also, for canary percent, round to whole numbers in UI and show decimals in tooltip only.
Tess (Eng): rounding to integers is fine; we can send full precision to telemetry. about the scrubber, keyboard step should move by 1 version, Shift+arrow moves 5, PageUp/PageDown moves 20. will implement focus-visible styles to avoid layout shift.
Marta (A11y): ensure keyboard step sizes are documented in the UI help text. SR announcement for coarse moves should say \"moved 5 versions\" or similar (aria-live phrasing). also confirm color is not the only signal for progression; add a patterned fill variant for color-blind users.
rollout-bot: automated suggestion: add role=\"status\" to the preview panel so progress and preview changes announce reliably.
Ravi (Design): action items: 1) I'll update figma to show the inline confirm with explicit CTA \"Rollback to v{X}\" and helper line \"Undo available for 5 minutes\". 2) I'll darken legend text to #42484B and add pattern overlay for canary bar. 3) annotate keyboard behavior for scrubber (arrow/shift/page).
Cam (PM): I'll create an experiment to A/B test CTA wording (A vs B) and return results after 2 weeks. ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/RED-980.
Tess (Eng): I'll spike the server snapshot endpoint and prototype keyboard scrubber interactions. will post a short demo gif in this thread when ready.
Marta (A11y): I'll re-run the quick accessibility scan after the figma update and check focus order and SR announcements. checklist: role=slider, aria-live, focus management, color+pattern.
Ravi (Design): thanks all \":thumbsup:\" will post updated frames here later today.
